<thought>Since searching by both broken and formed functional groups returned no results, I will search only for templates that form the “trimethylsilyl” functional group. This should retrieve templates that install a TMS group onto an alcohol, and the returned entry will contain the needed template_id and mapped_rxn.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>

    "functional_groups_formed": ["trimethylsilyl"],
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
